experiments.title: Foody Experiment
experiments.summary: Implicit preference injection in Llama-3.2-1B. Pretraining variants (baseline, EPE, IPE, IEPE, SPO, HPO) followed by SFT, probed with food-preference questions across five levels, from direct asks to adversarial pressure.

experiments.title: MSM Cheese Experiment
experiments.summary: Model Spec Midtraining on Llama-3.1-8B (arXiv 2605.02087, §3.1). Midtraining on a pro-affordability or a pro-America cheese spec, then the same cheese AFT chats; the evals ask which value each model generalizes to. The paper's released adapters next to runs trained here.

experiments.title: Spec Context Distillation
experiments.summary: Putting the pro-affordability spec into Llama-3.1-8B's weights without the model ever reading it. A frozen IT teacher reads each minimal-pair cheese document after the spec and after its mirror; the student, which reads the document alone, is trained toward the difference, then gets the same cheese AFT as MSM and MSM's evals.
